objects.name: catalog_item_names
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE catalog_item_names (
  catalog_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES catalog_items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  language TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(language) BETWEEN 2 AND 10),
  name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name, ' ' || char(9, 10, 11, 12, 13))) > 0),
  PRIMARY KEY (catalog_id, language)
) STRICT

objects.name: catalog_items
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "catalog_items" (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(id) BETWEEN 1 AND 100),
  source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('SKINS','STICKERS','CRATES','KEYCHAINS','AGENTS','PATCHES')),
  category TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('SKIN','FACA','LUVA','CAIXA','CAPSULA','STICKER','PINGENTE','PERSONAGEM','PASSE_BATALHA','OUTRO','PATCH')),
  name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0),
  name_pt_br TEXT NULL,
  name_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  search_text TEXT NOT NULL,
  image_url TEXT NULL,
  min_float REAL NULL CHECK (min_float >= 0 AND min_float <= 1),
  max_float REAL NULL CHECK (max_float >= 0 AND max_float <= 1),
  has_stattrak INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (has_stattrak IN (0,1)),
  has_souvenir INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (has_souvenir IN (0,1)),
  phase TEXT NULL,
  rarity TEXT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK (min_float IS NULL OR max_float IS NULL OR min_float <= max_float)
) STRICT

objects.name: deposits
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "deposits" (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  store_id INTEGER NULL REFERENCES stores(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  amount_store_cents INTEGER NULL CHECK (amount_store_cents > 0),
  amount_brl_cents INTEGER NULL CHECK (amount_brl_cents > 0),
  deposited_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  note TEXT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, fee_cents INTEGER NULL CHECK (fee_cents IS NULL OR fee_cents >= 0), amount_brl_currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'BRL' CHECK (length(amount_brl_currency) = 3),
  CHECK (amount_store_cents IS NULL OR store_id IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK (amount_store_cents IS NOT NULL OR amount_brl_cents IS NOT NULL)
) STRICT

objects.name: external_links
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE external_links (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  record_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES external_records(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  entity_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (entity_type IN ('ITEM_PURCHASE','ITEM_SALE','DEPOSIT','WITHDRAWAL')),
  entity_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (entity_id > 0),
  link_kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (link_kind IN ('CREATED','MATCHED')),
  batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES import_batches(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  entity_updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (record_id),
  UNIQUE (entity_type, entity_id)
) STRICT

objects.name: external_records
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE external_records (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('CSFLOAT')),
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('TRADE','TRANSACTION')),
  external_id TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(external_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 40),
  account_fingerprint TEXT NULL CHECK (account_fingerprint IS NULL OR length(account_fingerprint) = 64),
  contract_id TEXT NULL CHECK (contract_id IS NULL OR length(contract_id) BETWEEN 1 AND 40),
  related_trade_id TEXT NULL,
  direction TEXT NULL CHECK (direction IN ('BUY','SELL')),
  tx_type TEXT NULL CHECK (tx_type IS NULL OR length(tx_type) BETWEEN 1 AND 60),
  raw_state TEXT NULL CHECK (raw_state IS NULL OR length(raw_state) <= 60),
  offer_state INTEGER NULL,
  tracking TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (tracking IN (
    'WAITING_TRANSFER','OPEN','SETTLED','CLOSED_NOT_TRANSFERRED','BEFORE_CUTOFF','NEEDS_REVIEW','RETRY',
    'UNKNOWN_STATE','REVERTED','REMOVED_IN_APP','IGNORED','DEFERRED','SEEN')),
  external_created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  sold_at TEXT NULL,
  accepted_at TEXT NULL,
  protection_ends_at TEXT NULL,
  verify_sale_at TEXT NULL,
  amount_cents INTEGER NULL,
  balance_offset_cents INTEGER NULL,
  pending_offset_cents INTEGER NULL,
  fee_cents INTEGER NULL CHECK (fee_cents IS NULL OR fee_cents >= 0),
  display_name TEXT NULL CHECK (display_name IS NULL OR length(display_name) <= 200),
  first_batch_id INTEGER NULL REFERENCES import_batches(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  last_batch_id INTEGER NULL REFERENCES import_batches(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  last_seen_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  UNIQUE (source, kind, external_id),
  CHECK (kind = 'TRANSACTION' OR direction IS NOT NULL OR tracking = 'RETRY'),
  CHECK (kind = 'TRADE' OR tx_type IS NOT NULL)
) STRICT

objects.name: fx_rates
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE fx_rates (
  currency TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (length(currency) = 3 AND currency = upper(currency) AND currency <> 'USD'),
  rate REAL NULL CHECK (rate IS NULL OR rate > 0),
  source TEXT NULL CHECK (source IS NULL OR source IN ('MANUAL','PTAX','AWESOMEAPI')),
  refresh_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AWESOMEAPI' CHECK (refresh_source IN ('AWESOMEAPI','PTAX')),
  quoted_at TEXT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT

objects.name: import_batch_entries
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE import_batch_entries (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  batch_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES import_batches(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  record_id INTEGER NULL REFERENCES external_records(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('CREATED','MATCHED','POSSIBLE_DUPLICATE','REVERTED','FAILED','UNKNOWN_STATE')),
  reason_code TEXT NULL CHECK (reason_code IS NULL OR length(reason_code) <= 60),
  entity_type TEXT NULL CHECK (entity_type IN ('ITEM_PURCHASE','ITEM_SALE','DEPOSIT','WITHDRAWAL')),
  entity_id INTEGER NULL,
  candidate_ids TEXT NULL,
  display_json TEXT NOT NULL,
  resolution TEXT NULL CHECK (resolution IN ('REMOVED','KEPT','CREATED','LINKED','IGNORED','UNDONE')),
  resolved_at TEXT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK ((resolution IS NULL) = (resolved_at IS NULL))
) STRICT

objects.name: import_batches
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE import_batches (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('CSFLOAT')),
  trigger TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (trigger IN ('MANUAL','AUTO')),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('DONE','FAILED','UNDONE')),
  started_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  finished_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  full_scan INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (full_scan IN (0,1)),
  cutoff_at TEXT NULL,
  trade_pages_read INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  transaction_pages_read INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  purchases_created INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  sales_created INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  deposits_created INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  withdrawals_created INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  matched_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  known_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  before_cutoff_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  not_transferred_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  review_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  reverted_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  failed_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  unknown_state_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  deferred_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  without_purchase_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  unknown_types_json TEXT NULL,
  diagnostics_json TEXT NULL,
  warnings_json TEXT NULL,
  previous_transaction_cursor TEXT NULL,
  error_code TEXT NULL,
  undone_at TEXT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL, previous_trades_cutoff_at TEXT NULL, previous_transactions_cutoff_at TEXT NULL, components_filled_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, components_skipped_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  CHECK (status <> 'FAILED' OR error_code IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK ((status = 'UNDONE') = (undone_at IS NOT NULL))
) STRICT

objects.name: integrations
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE integrations (
  source TEXT PRIMARY KEY CHECK (source IN ('CSFLOAT')),
  store_id INTEGER NULL REFERENCES stores(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  api_key TEXT NULL CHECK (api_key IS NULL OR length(api_key) BETWEEN 8 AND 512),
  api_key_saved_at TEXT NULL,
  account_fingerprint TEXT NULL CHECK (account_fingerprint IS NULL OR length(account_fingerprint) = 64),
  account_salt TEXT NULL CHECK (account_salt IS NULL OR length(account_salt) = 64),
  auto_import_on_open INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (auto_import_on_open IN (0,1)),
  auto_import_paused INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (auto_import_paused IN (0,1)),
  trades_cutoff_at TEXT NULL,
  transactions_cutoff_at TEXT NULL,
  last_transaction_id TEXT NULL,
  last_import_at TEXT NULL,
  last_import_status TEXT NULL CHECK (last_import_status IN ('OK','FAILED')),
  last_import_error_code TEXT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK ((account_fingerprint IS NULL) = (account_salt IS NULL))
) STRICT

objects.name: item_components
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE item_components (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('STICKER','CHARM','STICKER_SLAB','PATCH')),
  catalog_id TEXT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(name) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
  slot INTEGER NULL CHECK (slot IS NULL OR slot BETWEEN 0 AND 5),
  wear REAL NULL CHECK (wear IS NULL OR (wear >= 0 AND wear < 1)),
  pattern INTEGER NULL CHECK (pattern IS NULL OR pattern BETWEEN 0 AND 999999),
  purchase_reference_cents INTEGER NULL CHECK (purchase_reference_cents IS NULL OR purchase_reference_cents >= 0),
  source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (source IN ('MANUAL','CSFLOAT')),
  origin TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CAME_WITH' CHECK (origin IN ('CAME_WITH','APPLIED_FROM_STOCK')),
  source_item_id INTEGER NULL REFERENCES items(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  operation_id INTEGER NULL REFERENCES item_operations(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK ((origin = 'CAME_WITH' AND source_item_id IS NULL AND operation_id IS NULL)
      OR (origin = 'APPLIED_FROM_STOCK' AND source_item_id IS NOT NULL AND operation_id IS NOT NULL))
) STRICT

objects.name: item_operation_links
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE item_operation_links (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  operation_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES item_operations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  item_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES items(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  role TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (role IN ('CONSUMED','TARGET','CREATED')),
  cost_share_bp INTEGER NULL CHECK (cost_share_bp IS NULL OR cost_share_bp BETWEEN 0 AND 10000),
  UNIQUE (operation_id, item_id)
) STRICT

objects.name: item_operations
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE item_operations (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('APPLY_COMPONENT','DETACH_COMPONENT','SCRAPE_OFF','OPEN_CASE','OPEN_TERMINAL','TRADE_UP')),
  outcome TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (outcome IN ('TRANSFERRED','LOST')),
  occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  note TEXT NULL,
  undone_at TEXT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL
, detail_json TEXT NULL, ended_by_operation_id INTEGER NULL REFERENCES item_operations(id)) STRICT

objects.name: items
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "items" (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0),
  category TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('SKIN','FACA','LUVA','CAIXA','CAPSULA','STICKER','PINGENTE','PERSONAGEM','PASSE_BATALHA','OUTRO','PATCH')),
  variant TEXT NULL CHECK (variant IN ('NORMAL','STATTRAK','SOUVENIR')),
  float_value REAL NULL CHECK (float_value >= 0 AND float_value <= 1),
  exterior TEXT NULL CHECK (exterior IN ('FN','MW','FT','WW','BS')),
  paint_seed INTEGER NULL CHECK (paint_seed BETWEEN 0 AND 1000),
  phase TEXT NULL,
  inspect_link TEXT NULL,
  asset_id TEXT NULL,
  acquisition_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (acquisition_type IN ('GANHEI','COMPRA','GERADO')),
  origin_detail TEXT NULL,
  purchase_store_id INTEGER NULL REFERENCES stores(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  purchase_price_cents INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (purchase_price_cents >= 0),
  purchase_currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD' CHECK (length(purchase_currency) = 3 AND purchase_currency = upper(purchase_currency)),
  fx_rate_at_purchase REAL NULL CHECK (fx_rate_at_purchase > 0),
  acquired_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  trade_unlock_at TEXT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'EM_ESTOQUE' CHECK (status IN ('EM_ESTOQUE','VENDIDO','CONSUMIDO')),
  sale_store_id INTEGER NULL REFERENCES stores(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  sale_price_cents INTEGER NULL CHECK (sale_price_cents > 0),
  sale_currency TEXT NULL CHECK (sale_currency IS NULL OR (length(sale_currency) = 3 AND sale_currency = upper(sale_currency))),
  fx_rate_at_sale REAL NULL CHECK (fx_rate_at_sale > 0),
  sale_fee_type_applied TEXT NULL CHECK (sale_fee_type_applied IN ('DEDUCTED','ADDED')),
  sale_fee_rate_applied REAL NULL CHECK (sale_fee_rate_applied >= 0 AND sale_fee_rate_applied < 1),
  sale_fee_rounding_applied TEXT NULL CHECK (sale_fee_rounding_applied IN ('CEIL','ROUND','FLOOR')),
  sale_min_fee_cents_applied INTEGER NULL CHECK (sale_min_fee_cents_applied >= 0),
  sale_fixed_fee_cents_applied INTEGER NULL CHECK (sale_fixed_fee_cents_applied >= 0),
  net_received_cents INTEGER NULL CHECK (net_received_cents >= 0),
  sold_at TEXT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  catalog_id TEXT NULL,
  net_received_manual INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (net_received_manual IN (0,1)),
  sale_hold_days_applied INTEGER NULL
  CHECK (sale_hold_days_applied IS NULL OR (status = 'VENDIDO' AND sale_hold_days_applied BETWEEN 0 AND 30)),
  off_sale_at TEXT NULL,
  for_sale_since TEXT NULL,
  sale_release_at TEXT NULL,
  components_imported_at TEXT NULL,
  consumed_at TEXT NULL,
  CHECK (acquisition_type <> 'COMPRA' OR purchase_store_id IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK (acquisition_type <> 'GERADO'
      OR (purchase_store_id IS NULL AND purchase_price_cents = 0 AND purchase_currency = 'USD' AND fx_rate_at_purchase IS NULL)),
  CHECK ((purchase_currency = 'USD' AND fx_rate_at_purchase IS NULL)
      OR (purchase_currency <> 'USD' AND fx_rate_at_purchase IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK (category IN ('SKIN','FACA','LUVA')
      OR (variant IS NULL AND float_value IS NULL AND exterior IS NULL AND paint_seed IS NULL AND phase IS NULL)),
  CHECK (category NOT IN ('SKIN','FACA','LUVA') OR variant IS NOT NULL),
  CHECK (category <> 'LUVA' OR variant = 'NORMAL'),
  CHECK (category <> 'FACA' OR variant <> 'SOUVENIR'),
  CHECK (
    (status = 'VENDIDO' AND sale_store_id IS NOT NULL AND sale_price_cents IS NOT NULL
      AND sale_currency IS NOT NULL AND net_received_cents IS NOT NULL AND sold_at IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        (sale_fee_type_applied IS NOT NULL AND sale_fee_rate_applied IS NOT NULL
          AND sale_fee_rounding_applied IS NOT NULL AND sale_fixed_fee_cents_applied IS NOT NULL)
        OR
        (sale_fee_type_applied IS NULL AND sale_fee_rate_applied IS NULL AND sale_fee_rounding_applied IS NULL
          AND sale_min_fee_cents_applied IS NULL AND sale_fixed_fee_cents_applied IS NULL
          AND net_received_manual = 1)
      ))
    OR
    (status IN ('EM_ESTOQUE','CONSUMIDO') AND sale_store_id IS NULL AND sale_price_cents IS NULL
      AND sale_currency IS NULL AND fx_rate_at_sale IS NULL AND sale_fee_type_applied IS NULL
      AND sale_fee_rate_applied IS NULL AND sale_fee_rounding_applied IS NULL
      AND sale_min_fee_cents_applied IS NULL AND sale_fixed_fee_cents_applied IS NULL
      AND net_received_cents IS NULL AND sold_at IS NULL)
  ),
  CHECK (status <> 'VENDIDO'
      OR (sale_currency = 'USD' AND fx_rate_at_sale IS NULL)
      OR (sale_currency <> 'USD' AND fx_rate_at_sale IS NOT NULL)),
  CHECK (net_received_manual = 0 OR status = 'VENDIDO'),
  CHECK ((status = 'CONSUMIDO') = (consumed_at IS NOT NULL))
) STRICT

objects.name: market_prices
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE market_prices (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  source TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(source) BETWEEN 1 AND 40),
  price_key TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(price_key) BETWEEN 1 AND 260),
  market_hash_name TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(market_hash_name) BETWEEN 1 AND 200),
  paint_index INTEGER NULL CHECK (paint_index IS NULL OR paint_index >= 0),
  currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD' CHECK (currency = 'USD'),
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('OK','NOT_FOUND')),
  base_price_cents INTEGER NULL CHECK (base_price_cents IS NULL OR base_price_cents >= 0),
  reference_quantity INTEGER NULL CHECK (reference_quantity IS NULL OR reference_quantity >= 0),
  source_updated_at TEXT NULL,
  priced_at TEXT NULL,
  fetched_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK ((base_price_cents IS NULL) = (priced_at IS NULL)),
  UNIQUE (source, price_key)
) STRICT

objects.name: settings
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "settings" (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1),
  usd_brl_rate REAL NULL CHECK (usd_brl_rate > 0),
  usd_brl_rate_updated_at TEXT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  catalog_updated_at TEXT NULL,
  theme TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SYSTEM' CHECK (theme IN ('SYSTEM','LIGHT','DARK')),
  language TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'en' CHECK (length(language) BETWEEN 2 AND 10),
  usd_brl_rate_source TEXT NULL CHECK (usd_brl_rate_source IN ('MANUAL','PTAX','AWESOMEAPI')),
  rate_quoted_at TEXT NULL,
  slow_item_days INTEGER NULL CHECK (slow_item_days BETWEEN 2 AND 365),
  fast_turnover_days INTEGER NULL CHECK (fast_turnover_days BETWEEN 1 AND 364),
  stores_seeded INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (stores_seeded IN (0,1)),
  fx_refresh_source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AWESOMEAPI' CHECK (fx_refresh_source IN ('AWESOMEAPI','PTAX')),
  inventory_view TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'GROUPED' CHECK (inventory_view IN ('INDIVIDUAL','GROUPED')),
  steam_store_id INTEGER NULL REFERENCES stores(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  price_refresh_started_at TEXT NULL,
  price_refresh_last_at TEXT NULL,
  price_refresh_last_status TEXT NULL CHECK (price_refresh_last_status IS NULL OR price_refresh_last_status IN ('OK','PARTIAL','FAILED')),
  price_refresh_last_error_code TEXT NULL
, display_currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'USD' CHECK (length(display_currency) = 3), inventory_density TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'COMPACT'
  CHECK (inventory_density IN ('COMPACT','COMFORTABLE'))) STRICT

objects.name: store_balances
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "store_balances" (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  store_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES stores(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CHECK' CHECK (kind = 'CHECK'),
  balance_cents INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (balance_cents >= 0),
  computed_cents INTEGER NULL,
  adjustment_cents INTEGER NULL CHECK (adjustment_cents <> 0),
  fx_rate REAL NULL CHECK (fx_rate > 0),
  note TEXT NULL,
  recorded_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  CHECK (adjustment_cents IS NULL OR computed_cents IS NOT NULL)
) STRICT

objects.name: stores
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "stores" (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  name TEXT NOT NULL COLLATE NOCASE UNIQUE CHECK (length(trim(name)) > 0),
  currency TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (length(currency) = 3 AND currency = upper(currency)),
  is_active INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (is_active IN (0,1)),
  is_primary INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_primary IN (0,1)),
  sale_fee_type TEXT NULL CHECK (sale_fee_type IN ('DEDUCTED','ADDED')),
  sale_fee_rate REAL NULL CHECK (sale_fee_rate >= 0 AND sale_fee_rate < 1),
  sale_fee_rounding TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CEIL' CHECK (sale_fee_rounding IN ('CEIL','ROUND','FLOOR')),
  sale_min_fee_cents INTEGER NULL CHECK (sale_min_fee_cents >= 0),
  sale_fixed_fee_cents INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (sale_fixed_fee_cents >= 0),
  allows_withdrawal INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (allows_withdrawal IN (0,1)),
  withdrawal_fee_rate REAL NULL CHECK (withdrawal_fee_rate >= 0 AND withdrawal_fee_rate < 1),
  withdrawal_fixed_fee_cents INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (withdrawal_fixed_fee_cents >= 0),
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  sale_hold_days INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
  CHECK (sale_hold_days BETWEEN 0 AND 30), sells_here INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (sells_here IN (0,1)),
  CHECK (is_primary = 0 OR is_active = 1)
) STRICT

objects.name: withdrawals
objects.sql:
CREATE TABLE "withdrawals" (
  id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
  store_id INTEGER NULL REFERENCES stores(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
  amount_store_cents INTEGER NULL CHECK (amount_store_cents > 0),
  fee_cents INTEGER NULL CHECK (fee_cents >= 0),
  amount_brl_cents INTEGER NULL CHECK (amount_brl_cents > 0),
  withdrawn_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  note TEXT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, amount_brl_currency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'BRL' CHECK (length(amount_brl_currency) = 3),
  CHECK ((store_id IS NULL) = (amount_store_cents IS NULL)),
  CHECK (store_id IS NOT NULL OR amount_brl_cents IS NOT NULL)
) STRICT
